name: Sequential Jumping Farthest Away (JFA)
definition: A sequential algorithm to compute the Signed Distance Field (SDF) and surface positions for a voxel grid by identifying boundary voxels and propagating distance information using a multi-scale search.
summary: Sequential JFA is a CPU-based algorithm that computes signed distance fields and closest surface points for voxel grids by propagating distance information sequentially with a halving stride.
